newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Farmer sales remain slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Farmer sales remain slow.

text.p: Farmers showed little interest in selling spring wheat on Wednesday, declining to be panicked by the continued slide in MGE futures levels, grain dealers in the northern U.S. grain belt said.
"They (farmers) have got their wading shoes on. They are just going to wait it out," one Montana based dealer said.
A sharp drop in temperatures shut off fieldwork in much of North Dakota and dealers reported more calls from farmers but no increase in the ranks of those willing to sell.
Basis bids for spring wheat remained steady, while MGE Dec closed down 3-1/2 cents at $3.98-1/4 a bushel.
"I didn't think it would go under $4.00 but I was wrong," one Montana merchandiser said. December has been drifting lower since setting a contract high of $6.34 in early May.
